notes.title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life | 7 days until the release!
notes.notes:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37268497/c502e82ff4e228376c55f6a120865b526500fcaa.jpg

Hello there!

We are only a week away from the release of the full version of My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life!

Have you added the game to your wishlist yet? Make sure you do to be the first to jump back into the story!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546060/My_Summer_Adventure_Memories_of_Another_Life/

To celebrate the upcoming release, we've decided to share this atmospheric piece of the game's soundtrack! 

Check it out:
https://youtu.be/IAJq2cr5wTI

Also, make sure to give a try to My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1! Free prologue of the game, where you can spend a whole day in this mystical story!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316340/My_Summer_Adventure_Memories_of_Another_Life__Day_1/

And leave a review if you've enjoyed it! That would really help and inspire us!

notes.title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1 | Free version is coming out May 4th!
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37268497/af220545b369c0e15785adb11cfff494ebae96fd.jpg

The free version of My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1 invites you to plunge into the first out of the four days in this mystical story, try on the shoes of a real Japanese student, and see the plot unfold around you. The protagonist was just a regular young man from Tallinn, but after dozing off on a train commute, he wakes up a completely different person in far-off Japan.

Add Free Prologue to your wishlist to be among the first to see what's going to happen next!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316340/My_Summer_Adventure_Memories_of_Another_Life__Day_1/

Also, feel free to add the full game to your wishlist! Release date is going to be announced very soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546060/My_Summer_Adventure_Memories_of_Another_Life/
